app.feature.1.desc: A labor of love from the MontageSubs community. We’ve baked fansubbing standards, workflows, and typography into a nonprofit, open-source tool. No fluff—just a simple way to get subtitles that actually look right and read naturally.
app.feature.1.title: Pro tools, open to everyone
app.feature.2.desc: Subtitles are living dialogue, not isolated lines. By optimizing the input structure, we help the engine grasp the scene’s pacing and rhythm. Combined with glossaries and QA, it keeps your terms consistent and timing precise.
app.feature.2.title: Beyond Line-by-Line
app.feature.3.desc: No installation. No accounts. No ads, no paywalls, no tracking. We’ve stripped away the noise and all the BS. Just a straightforward tool to get your subtitles translated, fast and clean.
app.feature.3.title: Clean and Direct
app.title: Neural Machine Translation for Subtitles
ass.sizeNote: Sets font sizes when exporting to ASS subtitles. Choose desktop or mobile presets, or customize sizes. With the split layout both languages share one size by default; stacked lines scale the secondary language down.

meta.about.description: About Montage Subtitle Translator, a free open-source subtitle translator built by the MontageSubs community: why we made it, how it works, and where it falls short.
meta.contribute.description: Ways to help Montage Subtitle Translator: improve docs and translations, report bugs, suggest ideas, or contribute code and resources. We don't accept monetary donations.

meta.tools.description: Free browser-based tools for subtitle makers from the MontageSubs community: SVG to ASS, ASS to SVG, and ASS font subsetting and embedding.
meta.translator.description: Free online subtitle translator. Translate SRT, VTT and ASS files in seconds with bilingual output, original timing kept, and 200+ languages. No sign-up, no ads.
model.deepl.desc: High-quality translation, but API costs currently exceed what our nonprofit service can support.
model.google.desc: Processes full-scene context in batches, preserving consistency across lines.
model.llm.desc: Costs roughly 50× as much as standard NMT, more than our free service can cover on its own.
model.local.desc: Engines that run on your own device are in development. Have one in mind?
